list.text: \f[facerival]\bAre you going to challenge the Pokémon League?
\f[facerival]\bThey are quite strong...\nMy Pokémon were not enough to beat that Dragon Tamer...
\f[facerival]\bI haven't given up on becoming the greatest Trainer...
\f[facerival]\bThere's still a bit of time left for me to become stronger and defeat the Indigo Pokemon League to secure my spot in the World Cup.

lines: EndSpeech: Não fique feliz com isso...

then.text: \f[facerival]\bI'm going to find out why I can't win and become stronger...
\f[facerival]\bWhen I do I'll challenge the Indigo Pokémon League again.
\f[facerival]\bI'll beat them with all my power.\n...Humph! I'll come to beat you then.
